readiness.why: No website custom audience can fill, so no Meta retargeting tier can run. Install the pixel first.

readiness.number: 2 of 2 links have personalised ads off
readiness.why: GA4 audiences can't be used for remarketing until personalised advertising is switched on in the link.

readiness.number: 6 of 6 standard key events silent for 90 days (sign_up, book_demo, form_submit, purchase, qualify_lead, close_convert_lead)
readiness.why: Converters can't be excluded from GA4 data. Upload a customer list of sign-ups and booked demos and exclude it everywhere.

readiness.number: last 7 days hold 90% of 30-day users; change date 2026-10-01
readiness.why: Traffic was tracked at the new level for only 5 days, so the 30-day pools cover 5 days. Run the skill again after 2026-10-31.
The two defaults (all users and purchasers, 540 days) and 3 test audiences (30, 1, 1 days). None matches a retargeting tier.

readiness.number: ad_group_audience_view on the connected linked account: 0 rows in 30 days; 48 of its 48 lists have 0 members
readiness.why: No ad group targets or excludes a list, so no enabled campaign uses one: the connected linked account is a test account, and the other linked account isn't connected. The tiers below become new lists.

readiness.number: 0 of 3 browse and cart metrics tracked; Active on Site is tracked
readiness.why: Klaviyo has no Viewed Product, Started Checkout or Added to Cart metric, so browse and cart flows can't trigger. Active on Site supports only a site-visit trigger.

funnel_now.why: The Meta ad account spent $0 in the last 30 days and served 0 impressions in 90 days.
funnel_now.detail: 2 ad sets, 2 paused, 2 with broad targeting and no custom audience, so both are TOF. There is no retargeting layer, and the account has 0 custom audiences.

email_and_paid_overlap.why: Klaviyo has 0 flows, and Meta has 0 retargeting audiences, so nothing overlaps yet.
email_and_paid_overlap.gaps: The Hot tier has neither an email flow nor an ad set, so pricing and demo visitors who leave hear nothing back.
email_and_paid_overlap.order_to_use: When flows exist, email goes first from day 0 and paid retargeting starts on day 2; paid excludes people who clicked the flow's email.

tiers.meta: under about 1,000 a month: merged into the next tier

tiers.tier: Warm: product, template library and docs visitors
Cool: all visitors (hotter tiers excluded in the platform)

tier_notes: Pools are unique people before exclusions; a person can sit in several page groups. Projections divide the 30-day pool by the 5 days since the change date and multiply by 30. They are upper bounds, because returning visitors are counted again.
Google Ads: Hot is recheck; Warm is viable; Cool is viable (100 active people in 30 days is the floor; recheck means the projection passes it, so build the list now and check it again).
Meta: Hot + Warm run as one Meta tier; Cool runs on its own. A merged tier runs the hotter tier's sequence.

budget.by_phase: about 50% in days 1–7, 30% in days 8–14, 20% in days 15–30
budget.spend_ceiling: unknown: the Meta account served 0 impressions in 90 days, under the 1,000 a usable CPM needs, and no Google Ads ad group used a list in 30 days

kpis.basis: no retargeting history, so these are outside starting points that vary by industry
monitor: frequency daily: above 4 a week on Cool, refresh creative
CTR weekly: below 0.2%, change message or creative
conversion rate weekly: if it falls, check the landing page
CPM weekly: rising on a flat audience means fatigue
cost per result weekly: once prospecting has a baseline, cut a tier that costs more

launch_checklist: Install the Meta pixel and confirm it fires
Switch on personalised advertising in the GA4 to Google Ads link
Upload a customer list of sign-ups and booked demos; exclude it everywhere
Create the three GA4 audiences (30 days) and the Meta website audiences
Launch Hot first on Google; add Warm and Cool after 3–7 days
Check exclusions after the first week; refresh creative every 2–3 weeks
Re-run this skill after 2026-10-31 to split the Meta tier when it grows
unknowns: Funnel performance (TOF, MOF, BOF): no delivery in 90 days
Email and paid overlap: no live flows and no paid retargeting
Google Ads list performance: no enabled campaign uses a list on the connected linked account (a test account), and the other linked account isn't connected
Spend ceiling per tier: no usable CPM
6 other key events (6 silent) are test or custom events and were left out
